title: A wall becomes protection
summary: Construction becomes a resource the town depends on, then danger passes beyond the defenses.

steps.event: Pristinia’s wall is finished
steps.connection: The completed wall later has a material role in defense.

steps.event: The Delerium assault reaches Pristinia
steps.connection: The wall holds a blow, but the assault brings contamination into town.

steps.event: Acolyte tests Pristinia’s walls
steps.connection: Later defenses face a new quest; this is continuing civic history, not proof of one unchanged threat.

title: Making Gael live again
summary: Restoration grows from material planning into living ground and woodland, with continued work and later loss.

steps.event: Gartina and Saray plan to restore Gael’s soil
steps.connection: Research and material care precede the later forest.

steps.event: Nienna gives herself so Hope can live
steps.connection: The Hallowing carries a chosen personal cost.

steps.event: Gartina plants Stake and brings forth a forest
steps.connection: Shared material work and planting create a larger living landscape.

steps.event: Hope, Stake, and Shadowangel Forest are present
steps.connection: Later testimony records the restored places already present in 2025.

title: Knowledge that outlives Anky
summary: Loss leads to shared records and research; an expedition ends with gaps that the surviving archive cannot fill.

steps.event: Voraketh takes something from Anky
steps.connection: Knowledge loss gives protected memory practical urgency.

steps.event: Coralyn and Anky form an early Chain model
steps.connection: A working model guides questions without settling the island’s purpose.

steps.event: Anky commissions the Voraketh map
steps.connection: Knowledge becomes something later travelers can inherit.

steps.event: Anky’s final recovered expedition begins
steps.connection: The record follows his return to investigation.

steps.event: St. Anky walks the road to the afterlife
steps.connection: The Wasteland scene now identifies the fatal chain-guard encounter; his records survive their maker.

title: Papirak’s inheritance becomes a public responsibility
summary: Burial, a disputed possession and an unfinished institution require choices from the living.

steps.event: Pell prepares Papirak’s burial and memorial
steps.connection: Care for the body becomes preparation for a civic farewell.

steps.event: Pristinia opens a vote on Papirak’s Staff of Power
steps.connection: Value, ownership and public need produce different proposals.

steps.event: Papirak’s staff is entombed under Sequester
steps.connection: The disposition is completed; suspicion does not change the observed burial.

steps.event: Papirak’s mourners turn toward living
steps.connection: Restoration is promised, while food and fellowship return people to living.

title: From the Common Man to Pilgrim’s Hearth
summary: Destruction becomes shared rebuilding, then ordinary social life returns.

steps.event: Zombie pirates burn the Common Man
steps.connection: The fire leaves a visible ruin and a need for rebuilding.

steps.event: Pristinia clears the Common Man’s ruins
steps.connection: People salvage, carry and donate toward a replacement.

steps.event: Pristinia’s cedar is stolen in Eovar
steps.connection: The rebuilding project connects Pristinia to a dispute beyond town.

steps.event: Pilgrim’s Hearth returns ordinary social life
steps.connection: Tea and conversation show what rebuilding has made possible.
